1.title: 春日景物与出行选择
1.subtitle: 从街上开花的树走到工作日的公园，安排新的出行日期。

steps.title: 春天街道上的花
steps.talkHint: 找街道、开花的树和边走边聊的两个人。
steps.prompt: 这条街在春天发生了什么变化？
steps.promptPinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē zài chūntiān fāshēng le shénme biànhuà?

steps.sentence: 春天到了，这条街上的树都开花了。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 街上的树都开花了。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Jiē shang de shù dōu kāihuā le.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 王一飞和白家月边走边聊。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Wáng Yīfēi hé Bái Jiāyuè biān zǒu biān liáo.

steps.title: 工作日的公园与小船
steps.talkHint: 找公园、湖面和停在岸边的小船。
steps.prompt: 她们今天能一起坐船吗？还可以选哪一天？

2.title: 天气突然变化与雨具
2.subtitle: 从晴天刮风到雨下起来，判断变化并互相帮助。

steps.title: 晴天突然刮起风来
steps.talkHint: 看人物的头发、衣服、树叶和变暗的天空。
steps.prompt: 刚才是什么天气？现在什么开始发生了？
steps.promptPinyin: Gāngcái shì shénme tiānqì? Xiànzài shénme kāishǐ fāshēng le?
steps.promptEn: What was the weather like just now, and what is starting now?
steps.sentence: 刚才还是大晴天，现在突然刮起风来了。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 刚才还是大晴天。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Gāngcái háishì dà qíngtiān.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 现在突然刮起风来了。

steps.title: 雨下起来，借出雨具
steps.talkHint: 找车门旁的一把伞、一件雨衣和正在互相帮助的两个人。
steps.prompt: 王一飞准备把什么借给白家月？

sampleAnswers.pinyin: Wáng Yīfēi shǒu li yǒu yì bǎ sǎn hé yí jiàn yǔyī.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 她可以把雨具借给白家月。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Tā kěyǐ bǎ yǔjù jiè gěi Bái Jiāyuè.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 这个季节天气变化很快。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Zhège jìjié tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài.

3.title: 气候体验与冬季雪景
3.subtitle: 在室内躲雨并比较长期居住后的天气感受。

steps.title: 教室里谈天气习惯
steps.talkHint: 找雨窗、门边的伞和正在交流的两个人。
steps.prompt: 在一个地方住一年多以后，什么容易习惯，什么不容易？
steps.promptPinyin: Zài yí gè dìfang zhù yì nián duō yǐhòu, shénme róngyì xíguàn, shénme bù róngyì?

steps.talkHint: 比较室内人物的感受和窗外的雪、树与风。

steps.sentence: 冬天虽然冷，但是下雪的时候特别漂亮。

grammar.title: 选择复句“或者……，或者……”
grammar.titleEn: Alternative complex sentence 或者……，或者……
grammar.scene: Observe how each 或者 introduces one possible plan.
grammar.structure: 或者 + 方案一，或者 + 方案二（，后续行动）
grammar.explanation: 重复使用“或者”列出两个或多个可能选择。它与选择问句“还是”有关，但这里是在陈述备选方案。

examples.hanzi: 或者明天去，或者后天去，我给你打电话。
examples.pinyin: Huòzhě míngtiān qù, huòzhě hòutiān qù, wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: Either we go tomorrow or the day after tomorrow; I will call you.

examples.hanzi: 周末我们或者去公园，或者去湖边。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen huòzhě qù gōngyuán, huòzhě qù húbiān.
examples.english: At the weekend we can go either to the park or to the lakeside.

examples.hanzi: 下午或者坐船，或者在街上看花。
examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ huòzhě zuò chuán, huòzhě zài jiē shang kàn huā.
examples.english: In the afternoon, either go boating or look at flowers on the street.

examples.hanzi: 晚饭或者吃中国菜，或者吃日本菜，或者吃泰国菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnfàn huòzhě chī Zhōngguó cài, huòzhě chī Rìběn cài, huòzhě chī Tàiguó cài.
examples.english: For dinner, choose Chinese, Japanese or Thai food.

examples.hanzi: 或者带伞，或者穿雨衣，选好以后我们就出发。
examples.pinyin: Huòzhě dài sǎn, huòzhě chuān yǔyī, xuǎn hǎo yǐhòu wǒmen jiù chūfā.
examples.english: Either bring an umbrella or wear a raincoat; after choosing, we will leave.

grammar.title: “起来”的引申用法
grammar.scene: Notice the moment an action starts or a new state begins.
grammar.structure: 动词 + 起来；动词 + 起 + 宾语 + 来
grammar.explanation: “起来”表示动作开始或进入新状态，不表示实际向上移动。动词有宾语时，宾语常放在“起”和“来”之间。

examples.hanzi: 怎么突然刮起风来了？
examples.pinyin: Zěnme tūrán guāqǐ fēng lái le?
examples.english: Why did it suddenly start to get windy?

examples.hanzi: 雨已经下起来了，咱们快点儿走吧。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ yǐjīng xiàqǐlai le, zánmen kuài diǎnr zǒu ba.
examples.english: It has started raining; let us hurry.

examples.hanzi: 看到春天的花，大家都笑了起来。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào chūntiān de huā, dàjiā dōu xiào le qǐlai.
examples.english: Everyone started smiling when they saw the spring flowers.

examples.hanzi: 音乐一响，学生们就唱起歌来。
examples.pinyin: Yīnyuè yì xiǎng, xuéshengmen jiù chàngqǐ gē lái.
examples.english: When the music began, the students started singing.

examples.hanzi: 四月以后，公园里慢慢热闹起来。
examples.pinyin: Sì yuè yǐhòu, gōngyuán li mànmàn rènao qǐlai.
examples.english: After April, the park gradually becomes lively.

grammar.title: 范围副词“就”
grammar.scene: First decide whether 就 highlights a small amount or points out an exception.
grammar.structure: 少：就 + 数量；例外：都……，就 + 例外
grammar.explanation: 本课只观察两种用法：强调数量少、时间短或程度轻；在一组情况中指出例外。

examples.hanzi: 北京常常下雪，但听说今年就下了一次。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng chángcháng xià xuě, dàn tīngshuō jīnnián jiù xiàle yí cì.
examples.english: It often snows in Beijing, but this year it snowed only once.

examples.hanzi: 他昨天就看了十分钟书。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān jiù kàn le shí fēnzhōng shū.
examples.english: He read for only ten minutes yesterday.

examples.hanzi: 我们在公园就坐了半个小时。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài gōngyuán jiù zuò le bàn ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: We stayed in the park for only half an hour.

examples.hanzi: 我每天书包里都放着雨伞，就今天没带。

examples.english: I carry an umbrella every day, except today.

examples.hanzi: 大家都习惯这里的天气了，就王老师还不太习惯。

examples.english: Everyone is used to the weather here except Ms. Wang.

grammar.title: “下来”的引申用法
grammar.scene: Look back after a long or difficult activity and describe the completed experience.
grammar.structure: 一段时间 / 一项任务 + 动词 + 下来
grammar.explanation: “下来”表示经过一段时间、付出努力或克服困难后完成、坚持或形成结果，不是实际向下移动。

examples.hanzi: 这一年多住下来，我还是更喜欢北京的四季。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yì nián duō zhù xiàlai, wǒ háishì gèng xǐhuan Běijīng de sìjì.
examples.english: After living here for over a year, I still prefer Beijing’s four seasons.

examples.hanzi: 一天走下来，我们看了很多开花的树。
examples.pinyin: Yì tiān zǒu xiàlai, wǒmen kàn le hěn duō kāihuā de shù.
examples.english: After walking all day, we saw many flowering trees.

examples.hanzi: 这本书看下来，我最喜欢最后一个故事。

examples.english: After finishing this book, I liked the last story best.

examples.hanzi: 这个小组任务做下来，大家学会了互相帮助。

texts.title: 春日公园计划
texts.setting: 在街上，王一飞和白家月边走边聊。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 王老师，您看，这条街上的树都开花了。
lines.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī, nín kàn, zhè tiáo jiē shang de shù dōu kāihuā le.
lines.english: Ms. Wang, look! The trees on this street are all in bloom.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 上周我去公园坐船了，公园里的花也开了。
lines.pinyin: Shàng zhōu wǒ qù gōngyuán zuò chuán le, gōngyuán li de huā yě kāi le.
lines.english: I went boating in the park last week, and the flowers in the park have bloomed too.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 天气这么好，下午我也想去公园坐船。
lines.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème hǎo, xiàwǔ wǒ yě xiǎng qù gōngyuán zuò chuán.
lines.english: The weather is so nice; I'd also like to go boating in the park this afternoon.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 去吧！今天是工作日，人应该不多。
lines.pinyin: Qù ba! Jīntiān shì gōngzuòrì, rén yīnggāi bù duō.
lines.english: Go ahead! Today is a weekday, so there shouldn't be too many people.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 您有时间吗？我想跟您一起去。
lines.pinyin: Nín yǒu shíjiān ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nín yìqǐ qù.
lines.english: Do you have time? I'd like to go with you.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 我今天下午有课，不能去太远的地方。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kè, bù néng qù tài yuǎn de dìfang.

texts.title: 突然变化的天气
texts.setting: 在街上，王一飞和白家月一起散步。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 刚才还是大晴天呢，怎么突然就刮起风来了？
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái háishì dà qíngtiān ne, zěnme tūrán jiù guāqǐ fēng lái le?
lines.english: It was broad daylight and sunny just now; why did it suddenly get windy?

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 好像新闻里说今天有雨。
lines.pinyin: Hǎoxiàng xīnwén li shuō jīntiān yǒu yǔ.
lines.english: It seems the news said there would be rain today.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 啊？我每天书包里都放着雨伞，就今天没带。
lines.pinyin: À? Wǒ měitiān shūbāo li dōu fàngzhe yǔsǎn, jiù jīntiān méi dài.
lines.english: Huh? I keep an umbrella in my bag every day, except today I didn't bring it.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 我可以借给你，我车里有一把伞和一件雨衣。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ jiè gěi nǐ, wǒ chē li yǒu yì bǎ sǎn hé yí jiàn yǔyī.
lines.english: I can lend you mine; I have an umbrella and a raincoat in my car.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 谢谢，希望下午天气能变好。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, xīwàng xiàwǔ tiānqì néng biàn hǎo.
lines.english: Thank you, I hope the weather turns better this afternoon.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 这个季节天气变化很快。
lines.pinyin: Zhège jìjié tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài.
lines.english: The weather changes very quickly in this season.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 雨已经下起来了，咱们快点儿走吧。
lines.pinyin: Yǔ yǐjīng xiàqǐlai le, zánmen kuài diǎnr zǒu ba.
lines.english: The rain has started to fall, let's hurry up.

texts.title: 习惯这里的天气
texts.setting: 在教室里，王一飞和白家月躲雨。
texts.editorialNote: 教材拼音中的 jīntiān / jīntián 疑似应为 jīnnián；正式数据按教材文本保留并标记待核。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 您来这里已经一年多了，习惯了吧？
lines.pinyin: Nín lái zhèlǐ yǐjīng yì nián duō le, xíguàn le ba?
lines.english: You've been here for over a year, you must be used to it by now?

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 别的早就习惯了，就是天气我还不太习惯。
lines.pinyin: Biéde zǎojiù xíguàn le, jiù shì tiānqì wǒ hái bú tài xíguàn.
lines.english: I got used to everything else long ago, except I'm still not quite used to the weather.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 为什么？您不喜欢这里的天气吗？
lines.pinyin: Wèishénme? Nín bù xǐhuan zhèlǐ de tiānqì ma?
lines.english: Why? Don't you like the weather here?

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 我觉得冬天太冷了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dōngtiān tài lěng le.
lines.english: I think winter is too cold.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 冬天虽然冷，但是下雪的时候特别漂亮。
lines.pinyin: Dōngtiān suīrán lěng, dànshì xià xuě de shíhou tèbié piàoliang.
lines.english: Although winter is cold, it's particularly beautiful when it snows.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 我也喜欢雪。北京常常下雪，但听说今年就下了一次。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuan xuě. Běijīng chángcháng xià xuě, dàn tīngshuō jīntiān jiù xiàle yí cì.
lines.english: I like snow too. It often snows in Beijing, but I heard it only snowed once this year.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 我没关注过北京的天气，但是新闻里说过，今年冬天很多地方雪下得都少了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méi guānzhù guo Běijīng de tiānqì, dànshì xīnwén li shuōguo, jīntián dōngtiān hěn duō dìfang xuě xià de dōu shǎo le.
lines.english: I haven't paid attention to the weather in Beijing, but the news mentioned that it snowed less in many places this winter.

texts.title: 北京四季日记
texts.author: 王一飞
texts.dateLabel: 在这里工作一年多以后
texts.setting: 在家里，王一飞在写日记。
texts.translationPolicy: 中文和拼音为教材原文；英文译文、日记标题和生活讨论为教学辅助。教材注释“不大多小”按原样记录为待核问题，不写入正式语法。

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 我离开北京到这里工作一年多了。这一年多住下来，我还是更喜欢北京的四季。北京的春天最舒服，天气不冷不热。夏天白天很热，但是晚上比较凉快。秋天树上的叶子都变成了红色、黄色，非常漂亮。冬天不但冷，而且风很大，我不喜欢冬天。每个人都有自己最喜欢的季节，你最喜欢哪个季节呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ líkāi Běijīng dào zhèlǐ gōngzuò yì nián duō le. Zhè yì nián duō zhù xiàlai, wǒ háishì gèng xǐhuan Běijīng de sìjì. Běijīng de chūntiān zuì shūfu, tiānqì bù lěng bú rè. Xiàtiān báitiān hěn rè, dànshì wǎnshang bǐjiào liángkuai. Qiūtiān shù shang de yèzi dōu biànchéng le hóngsè, huángsè, fēicháng piàoliang. Dōngtiān búdàn lěng, érqiě fēng hěn dà, wǒ bù xǐhuan dōngtiān. Měi gè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié, nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎge jìjié ne?
lines.english: I left Beijing and came here to work more than a year ago. After living here for over a year, I still prefer Beijing's four seasons. Spring in Beijing is the most comfortable—not cold and not hot. Summer days are hot, but evenings are cooler. In autumn, the leaves turn red and yellow and are very beautiful. Winter is not only cold but also very windy, so I do not like it. Everyone has a favorite season. Which season do you like best?

C.title: 我的天气、出行与四季生活指南

A.projectStage: 生活指南 1/3 · 选择活动
A.prompt_cn: 选择一个真实或合理的户外活动：天气、地点、日期和活动是什么？
A.prompt_en: Choose one realistic outdoor activity. What is the weather, place, possible date and activity?

A.projectStage: 生活指南 1/3 · 保存到最终展示
A.prompt_cn: 写清天气、地点、活动、两个日期选择和需要带的物品；至少使用一次“或者……，或者……”。
A.prompt_en: Create one outdoor activity plan card. State the weather, place, activity, two possible dates and what to bring. Use 或者……，或者…… at least once.
picturePrompts: 一张不含姓名、门牌或定位信息的地点或天气图片

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按句框完成5句话，并列出两个日期。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 独立写完整计划，自然使用“或者……，或者……”。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 比较两个地点或两个活动，说明选择依据和个人理由。

A.projectStage: 下一次课 · Outdoor Activity Plan Card
A.prompt_cn: Classroom Preparation: Outdoor Activity Plan Card
A.prompt_en: Bring your plan card and one privacy-safe place or weather image.
presentationPlan: Bring one self-made activity card and one privacy-safe photo of a place or weather condition.
Be ready to answer: What is the weather? Where will you go? What will you do? Which two dates are possible? What must you bring?
Use at least four lesson words and one complete 或者……，或者…… sentence.
Partners may compare plans and check language, but each student must speak. No audio upload is required.
A.classroomNote: Keep this card. You will add a weather-change response card in Homework B.

B.projectStage: 生活指南 2/3 · 记录变化
B.prompt_cn: 承接A的活动计划：原来是什么天气？后来什么开始发生？
B.prompt_en: Continue from Homework A. What was the original weather, and what started to happen later?
B.answerPlaceholder: 刚才 / 原来……，后来……起来了。

carryFrom.use: 继续使用同一个活动计划。

B.projectStage: 生活指南 2/3 · 保存到最终展示
B.prompt_cn: 说明天气变化、一个例外和应对办法。使用一个“起来”句和一个表示例外的“就”句，并说明要带、借或准备什么。
B.prompt_en: Create a weather-change response card. State the original weather, what started later, one exception, and what to bring, borrow or prepare. Use one 起来 sentence and one exception sentence with 就.
B.answerPlaceholder: 刚才……。后来……起来了。大家都……，就……。我需要带 / 借 / 准备……。
picturePrompts: 一张天气变化观察图或自己的简单天气时间线
一张不含个人隐私的雨具或应对方案图片

carryFrom.use: 说明原计划怎样受天气影响。

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按“原来—变化—例外—应对”四步完成句框。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 独立写完整变化过程，正确使用“起来”和例外“就”。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 比较两个应对方案，说明为什么选择其中一个。

B.projectStage: 下一次课 · Weather Change Response Card
B.prompt_cn: Classroom Preparation: Weather Change Response Card
B.prompt_en: Bring your Homework A plan card, this response card and one privacy-safe observation image or diagram.
presentationPlan: Bring the Homework A plan card, one weather-change card and one privacy-safe image or simple timeline.
Be ready to answer: What was the original weather? What started? What was the exception? What will you bring, borrow or prepare?
Use one 起来 sentence, one exception sentence with 就 and at least four lesson words.
Partners may check the timeline together, but each student must explain one part. No audio upload is required.
B.classroomNote: Keep both A and B cards. Homework C combines them into the final guide.

C.projectStage: 生活指南 3/3 · 连接A/B材料
C.prompt_cn: 把A的活动计划、B的天气变化和一个地方的四季特点连成六个要点。
C.prompt_en: Combine the Homework A activity plan, Homework B weather change, and the four-season features of one place into six points.

carryFrom.use: 天气变化、例外和应对办法。

C.taskLabel: 我的天气、出行与四季生活指南
C.projectStage: 生活指南 3/3 · 完成最终作品
C.prompt_cn: 整合A/B，介绍活动计划、一次天气变化、应对办法、一个地方的四季、最喜欢的季节和一段时间生活或学习下来的感受。至少使用6个本课词语和4个指定结构。
C.prompt_en: Create your final weather, travel and four-season life guide. Include one activity plan, one weather change, your response, the four seasons of one place, your favorite season and a reflection after living or studying for a period. Use at least six lesson words and all four required structures.
C.answerPlaceholder: 或者……，或者……。后来……起来了。大家都……，就……。四季……。我最喜欢……。这一段时间……下来，我……。
picturePrompts: 一张隐私安全的城市、校园、天气或季节图片

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按六部分句框准备，每部分说1—2句。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 独立完成1—2分钟连贯介绍，包含全部指定结构。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 比较两个城市、季节或活动计划，用天气信息和个人体验说明理由。

C.prompt_cn: Classroom Presentation: My Weather, Travel and Four-Season Life Guide
C.prompt_en: Give a 1–2 minute in-class presentation. An audio upload is not required.
presentationPlan: Bring your A plan card, B response card and one privacy-safe city, campus, weather or season image.
Answer all six points: activity plan, weather change, response, four-season features, favorite season and a longer-term experience.
Use at least six lesson words plus one 或者……或者…… sentence, one 起来 sentence, one 就 sentence and one 下来 sentence.
Groups may prepare and share visual materials, but every student must speak. Present for 1–2 minutes. No audio upload is required.
C.classroomNote: Mistakes and weak points stay collapsed until the student chooses to open them.

focus: 我的天气、出行与四季生活指南
